notes.title: v1.3.27 Patch for potential blank list of clients
notes.notes:
Fixed a rare condition in which a client might not create a quest, making the game unable to progress.
  This should retroactively fix the save if you reload your save.


If not, please reach out to me and I'll try to fix the save.
